Some of these drawings specifically addressed the split personality induced by the drug. He often included a miniature frigate, symbolically representing the prevalence of opium in the navy of the time. | Following his cure, in June 1925, Jean Cocteau held his first exhibition at the Galerie Briant-Robert, which on that occasion published an album of his drawings under the title Maison de Santé. | The signature "Jean l'Oiseleur" is one that Cocteau frequently used from the previous year, when he had published Les Mystères de Jean l'Oiseleur.
